why: Intro to Git and GitHub plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-git.json), 'See what changed with log and diff' (passes: git log shows three commits and git status reports a clean working tree). 'working tree clean' is from a `git status` run before the learner edited pancakes.md. `git diff` then shows the uncommitted '+- serve with maple syrup' line, and `git log` (still open in the pager, '(END)') lists two commits: the third was never made, and the tree is not clean any more.

step.title: Make a third commit and read the history
step.instructions: Add a line to pancakes.md and look at it with git diff. Commit it with git commit -am "Add syrup note". Then run git log to see three commits and git status to check the tree is clean.

files.cookbook/pancakes.md:
# Pancakes

- 1 cup flour
- 1 cup milk
- 2 eggs
- pinch of salt
- serve with maple syrup

Terminal: nothing to commit, working tree clean
